Census Records
Preserved Primary Document • census.htm
Like many people interested in genealogy, I began the search
for my ancestors with the census records. These lists were
compiled many years ago and doubtless contain many errors and
ommissions.
One day I would like to go back and check
all the data against the original sources which I would urge
anyone using these records to do.
Also, like most records, they contain the errors made by the
original record-keepers. Please use them with caution and always
refer back to the originals.

clean_html:
Census Records

Preserved Primary Document • census.htm

Like many people interested in genealogy, I began the search for my ancestors with the census records. These lists were compiled many years ago and doubtless contain many errors and ommissions. One day I would like to go back and check all the data against the original sources which I would urge anyone using these records to do. Also, like most records, they contain the errors made by the original record-keepers. Please use them with caution and always refer back to the originals.
